[[Chidehkir's Deliverance]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Chidehkir, Light of the Blind]], a [[boss]] in the [[Marga Coast]].

==Stats==
:[[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]])
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Healing Rod]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Quickening]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription
*Dye won't work on those crafter's items

* [[Mallyx's Faith]] and [[Peace]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Fire damage]] and require [[Divine Favor]].
* [[Imperial Dragon Wand]], [[The People's Will]] and [[Xun Rao's Justice]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Fire damage]] and require [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
* [[Plague-Soaked Stave]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires Divine Favor, Soul Reaping, Fast Casting, Energy Storage, or Spawning Power.
